name: Surface Spawn & Visual Presence Pass
scope: Surface-first SKY SPAWN usability and visual-presence pass: add body-aware NEAR/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH shells, make preview-body apparent size track true angular size while keeping a separate amber aiming ring, collapse the large setup card during live aiming, add restrained FOV-aware solar glare on landed worlds, and improve resolved planet/moon texture filtering/detail residency in orbit. No authoritative gravity/orbit/landing equations are changed.
sandboxParentsValidated: Any currently landed planet/moon supported by the existing surface stack; SOL acceptance focuses Earth, Moon, Mars, Europa, Titan and Triton where landing is already enabled.
sandboxDynamicsPolicy: Preview is render-only. Commit recomputes a two-body circular state against the parent's current live position/velocity, then inserts the asteroid as a normal gravity source. From that instant onward the existing mutual Newtonian velocity-Verlet N-body integration is authoritative and perturbations/collisions are allowed.
sandboxReferenceStatePolicy: Surface COMMIT re-solves the astronomical observer, parent state, body rotation, reticle look vector and orbital-shell intersection at the exact commit instant. The body is inserted on that line of sight with a circular prograde tangent; subsequent motion is entirely live mutual Newtonian N-body evolution.
sandboxPreviewPolicy: PREVIEW remains presentation-only and follows the live landed reticle direction. The ghost now follows true apparent angular size with only a tiny visibility floor; the separate amber ring remains a larger aiming aid. PREVIEW collapses the setup card into a compact strip so the sky stays visible. The projected orbit never participates in gravity.
flightNavigationPolicy: Gravity solver, velocity-Verlet integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL reference states, planetary rotation, atmospheric optics, landing transitions and takeoff/orbit handoff remain inherited and are not redesigned in 0.1.0.6A.
mobileCachePolicy: Changed shell/style/main/app/renderer/surface-renderer/celestial-renderer/orbit-sandbox edges are stamped ue0106a2 for Safari/GitHub Pages cache isolation; unchanged validated physics/data/surface-state dependencies retain their prior URLs.
surfaceSkySpawnPolicy: Actual landed/on-foot surface only; reference SURFACE SKY observer remains excluded. Reticle must be at or above the local horizon. Current landed body is automatically the orbital parent. Surface presets are NEAR/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH; NEAR is the closest supported circular shell in the current gravity model and does not model atmospheric drag or non-spherical gravity.
visualPresencePolicy: Sun position/angular geometry remain authoritative; only display glare/white-core presentation is strengthened and reduced progressively at telescope FOV. Planet/moon orbit polish is rendering-only: higher-quality mip/anisotropic filtering and earlier lazy detail residency, with physical radius, lighting geometry and body state unchanged.
